title: The Transformative Power of Community: Stronger and Better Together
description: THE TRANSFORMATIVE POWER OF COMMUNITYCommunity has the power to change us and the world. Community is both a gift that is given to us and a need everyone has. We were made for community. It is through community that we are given opportunities for restoring our nature as divine. We grow spiritually and experience wholeness through community. Community can be the scene where brokenness is healed. Times of aloneness can prepare us for more fulfilling experiences of community. Change-agent leaders use community to confront injustice and bring about a more just world. Love and acceptance are found in community. Barriers to community are many and are adding to feelings of loneliness and isolation. However, these barriers can be overcome. We can find meaning and purpose in community. We can discover who we were meant to be and how our unique personalities and gifts are useful to others.Community is necessary for the redemption and salvation of the world. While God is the One who redeems and saves us, most of this work is done in the numerous contexts of community. God gives us the opportunity to work with Him in the important work of spiritual transformation and wholeness through community. Life is about relationships: relationship with God and with those around us. title: The Transformative Power of Performance: A New Aesthetics
description: In this book, Erika Fischer-Lichte traces the emergence of performance as 'an art event' in its own right. In setting performance art on an equal footing with the traditional art object, she heralds a new aesthetics. The peculiar mode of experience that a performance provokes – blurring distinctions between artist and audience, body and mind, art and life – is here framed as the breeding ground for a new way of understanding performing arts, and through them even wider social and cultural processes. With an introduction by Marvin Carlson, this translation of the original Ästhetik des Performativen addresses key issues in performance art, experimental theatre and cultural performances to lay the ground for a new appreciation of the artistic event.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2"]', '#CardInstanceiG2JrsWvcHtcc0wnIZIs7w')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_popover_inner__3tPIV{padding:20px 24px 0;width:65vw}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K{height:15vh;margin-top:10vh;text-align:center}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_no_email_alert__1t6PT{margin-bottom:60px}a[id^=tellAmazonDropdown],a[id^=tellAmazon_][id*=Dropdown]{white-space:normal!important} ._tell-amazon-desktop_s

title: The Transformative Power of Near-Death Experiences: How the Messages of NDEs Can Positivel
description: Discover the positive effects of NDEs in this “well-written and thought-provoking” study full of near-death experience true stories (Anita Moorjani, New York Times –bestselling author of Dying to Be Me ). Near-death experiences (NDEs) are often transformative—not only on an individual level, but on a collective level too. This book contains a selection of inspiring stories from ordinary people whose extraordinary experiences have changed the course and direction of their lives, opening each and every one of them to the power of divine love. Recent years have seen a dramatic change of attitude towards near-death experiences. Unfortunately, the ongoing debates about near-death experiences have detracted greatly from their transformational effects and how empowering they can be for the whole of mankind. For those who experience them, near-death experiences often instill the knowledge that we are all interconnected and part of one great whole. This book aims to inspire people from all walks of life, creeds, cultures, and faiths to the transformational power of the message of near-death experiences—and to show how the love experienced during the NDE has the capacity to heal minds, bodies and souls.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1"]', '#CardInstancevHiBoTxWu30frWTMWjk6YA')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20

title: The Transformative Power of Small Groups: A 7-Step Guide for Building Vibrant Catholic Com
description: In an era marked by Eucharistic revival, synodal renewal, and Jubilee celebrations, Fr. Michael White and Tom Corcoran—the bestselling authors of Rebuilt —offer a practical guide to revitalizing your parish through small groups. In The Transformative Power of Small Groups: A 7-Step Guide for Building Vibrant Catholic Communities , they show you how to foster faith-based friendships, which result in vibrant communities that not only sustain Christian love and service but also change the world. Winner of a 2026 Excellence in Publishing award from the Association of Catholic Publishers in Resources for Ministry. Winner of 2026 CMA Book Award in Pastoral Ministry - Parish Life (Honorable Mention) and 2026 CMA Book Award in Church Professional (Second Place) from the Catholic Media Association. This concise guide shows how small groups can become the backbone of your parish’s pastoral care, discipleship, and evangelization efforts. Through their signature blend of engaging storytelling—highlighting real-life successes and struggles—White and Corcoran share examples of how small group members rally around each other during times of crisis, challenge one another toward spiritual growth, and provide meaningful support in everyday life. Whether you’re a parish leader or a dedicated parishioner, you’ll learn how to: Understand the transformative impact of small groups on spiritual growth and community building Easily organize and structure small groups for all ages and ministries, with minimal time and resources Choose engaging content and resources that inspire participation and growth. title: The Art of Fighting: The Transformative Power of Conflict
description: AN INSTANT NEW YORK TIMES BESTSELLER FEATURED AT NBC’S TODAY SHOW, NEW YORK TIMES MAGAZINE , THE WALL STREET JOURNAL , AND MANY MORE “This is not just a book about having better arguments, it's a manual for building stronger relationships.”—Adam Grant “A paradigm-shifting examination of how we can get along better by understanding the role of conflict in our lives more deeply.” —Jefferson Fisher “Priya Parker offers a generous, radically helpful guide through our divides—without flattening what makes us different.” — Suleika Jaouad A paradigm-shattering exploration of how we fight and how we build healthy conflict, from the bestselling author of The Art of Gathering We say we want community. Successful teams. High-performing colleagues and workplaces. Dynamic friend groups. Yet many of us don’t understand the crucial element we need to forge long-lasting communities in our lives: healthy conflict. In The Art of Fighting , Priya Parker explains that we can’t form and grow effective relationships without a fight. She rejects the idea that conflict is abnormal or that good groups don’t fight. All groups change and evolve; indeed, it’s because people disagree that good groups flourish. As she did in the now-classic The Art of Gathering , Parker draws on her far-reaching experience as a conflict facilitator, her own detailed research, and real-world examples to lay out the ways that people can identify disputes, determine how to address them, and what to do if they are insurmountable. Whether people disagree in the boardroom or the locker room, on a playground or in church, online or in person, conflict is a part of life, and understanding healthy conflict and how to harness its power is more important than ever. title: All for Love: The Transformative Power of Holding Space
description: "Gold Medal in Inspirational/Spiritual" Independent Publisher Book Awards "Winner – World Vision Books" Ommie Awards Awaken your inner healer, transform conflict, and embrace our ever-changing world with confidence and compassion. Love thy neighbor. Lovingkindness. The love of the universe. From traditional religions to new spirituality, love is the foundation on which all practice rests. We all embrace the idea of love … and then we get on social media. Or read the news. Or visit family. Whether divided by race, gender, sexual orientation, identity preference, or opinion, the incredible moral and social chasms in our world have become a source of pain and confusion for so many people. We know that love and unity are beautiful ideals, but the question remains: How do we get there? In what may be his boldest and bravest book yet, bestselling author Matt Kahn invites us to see our differences as golden opportunities to explore the depth of our interconnectedness. Offering wise insights and tangible tools, Matt teaches us how to remain aligned with our highest truths and values while we hold space for the experiences of others. Throughout the book, Matt shares ten essential principles—mercy, worthiness, bravery, and more—that help us access the highest and most loving qualities within ourselves and those around us. Each chapter contains personal stories and real-world applications, guiding us to reach into our own hearts and give one another the respect, validation, and encouragement needed to make it through the evolutionary shifts before us—shifts into greater unity and greater love.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8"]', '#CardInstanceE4OrdgZoYnkZ8F_-mFdqxA')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-des

title: The Transformative Power of Baptism: Born of Water & Spirit
description: Baptism is not an empty religious ceremony, a family tradition, or merely a moment beneath the water. It is a decisive response of faith—a public declaration that the old life no longer has the final word and that your heart, your identity, and your future belong to Jesus Christ. When a surrendered believer enters the water, baptism proclaims a death, a burial, and a resurrection. The past goes into the water, but it does not determine what comes out. Shame no longer owns you. Sin no longer defines you. Your failures are no longer stronger than God’s mercy. You rise declaring that you belong to Jesus and are ready to walk in the new life only He can give. The Transformative Power of Baptism: Born of Water & Spirit takes readers beyond tradition and into the life-changing biblical truth of baptism. From John the Baptist and the opened heavens to the cross, the resurrection, Pentecost, and the transformation of the apostle Paul, this book reveals what it means to repent, believe, surrender, and rise as a new creation in Christ. Through powerful biblical teaching, readers will discover: • Why Jesus chose to be baptized • Why repentance and faith must come before the water • What it means to be born of water and the Spirit • How baptism reflects death, burial, and resurrection • The difference between outward water and the inward, transforming work of the Holy Spirit • Why no past is beyond the cleansing power and mercy of Jesus • How to walk in freedom, spiritual growth, and an intimate relationship with Christ The water did not bleed for you. Jesus did. The water did not carry your sins to the cross. Jesus did. The water did not conquer death and rise from the grave. Jesus did. The water is not the Savior. title: THE TRANSFORMATIVE POWER OF OPENHEARTED SINCERITY: The Urgency and Opportunity of our Time
description: Through willingness and sincerity, the soul discovers the supernal nature within the innermost depths of the human constitution: it is an ideal principle that is immanently accessible at the locus of the individual heart. In a poetical sense, there now begins a metaphoric event such as we find in nature, as a lower earthbound creature transforms to flight. In this case, the human being is conscious and aware and the transformation is from a lesser mentality to one that promises liberation. In a similar way, the immanent presence that we find within our sincere hearts epitomizes the completed transformation and now returns to inwardly guide the fledgling into flight. Through this simple analogy one finds a significant parallel. But the human qualitative metamorphosis is gradual and we develop at our own pace. We cannot know where the process will lead but we progress step by step and,turning receptively inward in the earlier described manner, openhearted sincerity becomes second nature with usage. The approach requires susceptibility which means we open our hearts to receive. We ourselves have nothing to give anymore than a child is required to compensate its parents. And of course, we are not in charge. There is no sense in telling the supernal what to do. Spontaneous openhearted sincerity is of considerably greater consequence than a meditational discipline or doctrinal preparation and of particular importance as a ready expedient during an extremity. In other words, like the musician who hones a skill more effectively in public concert than in practice session, we, too, expedite our progress when the heart is rendered susceptible as a constant resource under practical circumstances. title: The Transformative Power of Repentance
description: This book offers a profound exploration of genuine repentance as the key to experiencing personal transformation and spiritual revival . With a direct and challenging approach, the author exposes the superficial nature of modern "repentance" , which is often reduced to a mere intellectual acknowledgment of sin without any real change of heart. Through insightful analysis of Scripture, the author reveals the true meaning of biblical repentance : a radical turning from sin to holiness , a complete abandonment of rebellion against God , and an unconditional surrender to the divine will . This book will confront you with the urgency of genuine revival , guiding you toward experiencing the transforming grace of forgiveness and restoration . This book delves into the need for true and deep repentance as the foundation for an authentic Christian life. It draws on teachings about the superficiality of today's "repentance" , which often lacks genuine conviction of sin and fails to produce any real change in attitude or conduct. The consequences of false repentance : Examines the dangers of superficial repentance that fails to produce a real change of heart.
